<solution_file path="src/solution.py">
import pandas as pd
import csv

# Read the input file
df = pd.read_csv('outputs/t11_city_indicator_matrix.csv')

# Get indicator columns (all columns except city_id, city_name, year)
indicator_cols = [col for col in df.columns if col not in ['city_id', 'city_name', 'year']]

# Calculate missingness for each indicator
missingness_report = []
for col in indicator_cols:
    missing_count = df[col].isna().sum()
    missing_rate = missing_count / len(df)
    kept = missing_rate <= 0.30
    missingness_report.append({
        'indicator': col,
        'missing_count': int(missing_count),
        'missing_rate': missing_rate,
        'kept': kept
    })

# Create missingness report DataFrame
missingness_df = pd.DataFrame(missingness_report)

# Save missingness report (RFC 4180 compliant - pandas handles quoting)
missingness_df.to_csv('outputs/t12_missingness_report.csv', index=False, quoting=csv.QUOTE_MINIMAL)

# Select columns to keep (city_id, city_name, year, and kept indicators)
selected_cols = ['city_id', 'city_name', 'year']
for col in indicator_cols:
    if missingness_df[missingness_df['indicator'] == col]['kept'].iloc[0]:
        selected_cols.append(col)

# Create selected matrix
selected_df = df[selected_cols]

# Save selected matrix (RFC 4180 compliant - pandas handles quoting)
selected_df.to_csv('outputs/t12_selected_matrix.csv', index=False, quoting=csv.QUOTE_MINIMAL)
</solution_file>
